text: The NR DAP is the first multi-hazard regional plan in NSW, addressing nine natural hazards. It follows a phased development approach, starting with a foundation DAP that includes early risk-reduction actions and community engagement, followed by a full DAP after options assessment. Unique features include social asset mapping, the first regional flood evacuation model, and the integration of cultural burning and nature-based measures. The plan emphasizes community co-design and engagement, with workshops and surveys to capture community values and priorities.
